# CircleCI status-check contexts that MUST be required by a ruleset protecting
# main. One context per line; blank lines and # comments are ignored.
#
# NO SUCH RULESET EXISTS TODAY, so every gate below blocks the pipeline and none
# blocks a merge. Creating it is an owner action, and required-checks-drift
# flips to blocking in that same change.
# The strings are stable because every scan instance carries an explicit
# `name:`, so CircleCI cannot renumber them. Confirm with `gh pr checks <PR>`.

# Compiles, clippy, and the integration test that helm-lints a rendered chart
ci/circleci: build-and-test

# Dependency CVEs, fixable CRITICAL/HIGH, waivers subtracted at gate time
ci/circleci: dependency-cve-scan

# Dockerfile and template misconfiguration, plus the credential guard
ci/circleci: misconfig-scan

# SAST tier 1: full repo, ERROR band
ci/circleci: sast-scan

# SAST tier 2: newly introduced WARNINGs, the only tier that gates Rust
ci/circleci: sast-scan-diff

# Waiver and disposition integrity, plus any shrinkage of SAST scope
ci/circleci: disposition-check

# Base images and reference services: fixable CRITICAL/HIGH, image-config
# secret pass, EOL base-OS check
ci/circleci: py12base
ci/circleci: py12cugraph
ci/circleci: py12torch
ci/circleci: node22base
ci/circleci: test-service
ci/circleci: test-service-nodejs

# NOT REQUIRED YET, deliberately:
#   ci/circleci: secret-scan
#     Report-only for one enumeration cycle so genuine fixtures get dated
#     allow-rules first. Add when fail-on-findings flips.
#   ci/circleci: required-checks-drift
#     Warn-only by construction; a check that cannot fail adds no protection.
